HALO is a No-kill, 501c3 non-profit organization dedicated to Helping Animals Live On through increased adoption, sterilization and pet care education.

HALO was founded in 1994 by two women, Michel and Heather, out of their home in Phoenix, Arizona. Michel and Heather started HALO because they love animals and couldn't just stand by and watch millions of cats and dogs being killed needlessly.

HALO provides temporary shelter to abandoned cats and dogs until they can be adopted into a permanent home.

Each year, HALO places over 3,000 abandoned animals in loving, forever homes.
